## Set Up Workspace

```{r,  warning=F, message=F}
# Load packages and functions
source("../RMDFiles/Load Packages and Functions.R")
source("R_rainclouds.R")

# Load data
LayBeliefs <- read_csv("StabilityBeliefs_Data.csv") %>% 
  mutate(group = 1,
         beliefs.F = factor(beliefs, 
                            labels = c("(1) Emotional more stable",
                                       "(2)",
                                       "(3) Neither more stable",
                                       "(4)",
                                       "(5) Rational more stable")))

```

<br>

## Analyses

Summary of lay belief endorsement:

```{r}
psych::describe(LayBeliefs$beliefs) %>% select(n, mean, sd, se) %>% 
  as_tibble() %>% mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 2) %>% 
  htable()
```

<br>

### One-Sample t-Test

```{r}
d <- effsize::cohen.d(d = LayBeliefs$beliefs, f = NA, mu = 3)
t.test(LayBeliefs$beliefs, mu = 3) %>% 
  broom::tidy() %>% mutate(p.value = ifelse(p.value < .001, "< .001", p.value)) %>%
  select(-method, -alternative, -conf.low, -conf.high) %>% #Omitting CIs around mean difference
  mutate(Cohen.d = d$estimate, 
         conf.low = as.vector(d$conf.int[1]),
         conf.high = as.vector(d$conf.int[2])) %>% 
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, 2) %>% 
  rename(`Mean Difference` = estimate, t = statistic, df = parameter) %>% 
  htable()
```

<br>

### Percentage Endorsement

```{r}
table(LayBeliefs$beliefs.F) %>% prop.table() %>% as.data.frame() %>% 
  rename(Response = Var1, Percentage = Freq) %>% 
  mutate(Percentage = round(100*Percentage,1)) %>% 
  htable()
```

<br>

### Raincloud Plot

```{r, fig.align = 'center', fig.asp=.5}
labels <- c("1\nEmotional\nmore stable",
            "2\n ",
            "3\nNeither\nmore stable",
            "4\n ",
            "5\nRational\nmore stable")
Fig1 <- ggplot(LayBeliefs, aes(x=group,y=beliefs, fill = group, color = group)) +
  geom_flat_violin(position = position_nudge(x = .25, y = 0), adjust = 2) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = .15), size = .25) +  
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = as.numeric(group) + 0.25, y = beliefs), 
               outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.3, width = .1, 
               colour = "BLACK") + 
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "") + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = 1:5,labels = labels) +
  coord_flip() + theme_cowplot() + 
  guides(fill = FALSE, colour = FALSE) +
  theme(text=element_text(family="Times New Roman", size=12), 
        axis.title.y=element_blank(), axis.text.y=element_blank(),
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank())

ggsave(plot = Fig1, "Figure1.png", type = "cairo-png", 
       dpi = 300, width = 6, height = 3.5, units = "in") #Save graph

print(Fig1)
```
